stem.text: The diagram shows the immune response following infection by a virus.

stem.alt: Diagram of an immune response to a virus: cell divisions and differentiation shown with arrows, dashed arrows for chemical stimulation, a host cell infected with virus, and secretion of antibodies, with cells labelled E, F, G and H.

stem.text: Which row identifies the cells labelled E, F, G and H?

A.text: B-memory cell; T-helper cell; T-killer cell; plasma cell

B.text: B-memory cell; T-memory cell; macrophage; plasma cell

C.text: plasma cell; T-memory cell; T-helper cell; B-memory cell

D.text: T-killer cell; B-memory cell; macrophage; T-helper cell
